endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_gaussian_marginal_density
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ {C₀ δ κ σ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          0 < σ →
            δ ≤ σ →
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
                ∀ (f : RectangleCLT.Face p) (a : ℝ),
                  ∫ (ω : Ω),
                      ProbabilityTheory.gaussianPDFReal 0 1 ((RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f (V ω) - a) / σ) /
                        σ ∂μ ≤
                    16 * Real.exp (1 / 2) * C₀ * κ

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_gaussian_pair_density
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReference_normal_integral_le_volume

  Measurable F →
    MeasureTheory.Integrable F MeasureTheory.volume →

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair_normal_fiber_bound
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ (s c : ℝ) {h σ ν : ℝ},
  0 < h →
    0 < σ →
      0 < ν →
        ∫ (t : ℝ), RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair (s, (c + σ * ν * t) / h) ∂ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1 ≤
          h / (2 * σ * ν) * RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferenceSingle s

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_oneFace_normal_average
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ {C₀ δ κ h : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          0 < h →
            δ ≤ h →
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
                ∀ (η : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ) [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure η]
                  (f : RectangleCLT.Face p) (σ a : ℝ),
                  ∫ (ω : Ω),
                      ∫ (t : ℝ),
                        RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferenceSingle
                          ((RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f (V ω) + σ * t - a) / h) ∂η ∂μ ≤
                    4 * C₀ * h * κ

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_pair_normal_reference_mass
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ {C₀ δ κ h σ ν : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          0 < h →
            0 < σ →
              0 < ν →
                δ ≤ h →
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
                    ∀ (η : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ) [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure η]
                      (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p) (ρ a b : ℝ),
                      ∫ (z : Ω × ℝ × ℝ),
                          RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair
                            ((RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f (V z.1) + σ * z.2.1 - a) / h,
                              (RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot g (V z.1) + σ * ρ * z.2.1 + σ * ν * z.2.2 - b) /
                                h) ∂μ.prod (η.prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)) ≤
                        2 * C₀ * h ^ 2 * κ / (σ * ν)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.intrinsicRectangleConcentration_pair_angular_reference_mass
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {Ω : Type u_1} [inst : MeasurableSpace Ω] {p : ℕ} (μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω)
  [inst_1 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure μ] (V : Ω → RectangleCLT.Vector p),
  Measurable V →
    ∀ {C₀ δ κ h σ ν ℓ : ℝ},
      0 ≤ C₀ →
        0 ≤ κ →
          0 < h →
            0 < σ →
              0 < ν →
                δ ≤ h →
                  RectangleCLTArxivV1.IntrinsicRectangleConcentration (MeasureTheory.Measure.map V μ) C₀ δ κ →
                    0 ≤ ℓ →
                      ℓ ≤ Real.pi * ν →
                        ∀ (η : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ) [inst_2 : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure η]
                          (f g : RectangleCLT.Face p) (ρ a b : ℝ),
                          ℓ *
                              ∫ (z : Ω × ℝ × ℝ),
                                RectangleCLTArxivV1.hReferencePair
                                  ((RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot f (V z.1) + σ * z.2.1 - a) / h,
                                    (RectangleCLT.FaceSmoother.normalDot g (V z.1) + σ * ρ * z.2.1 + σ * ν * z.2.2 -
                                        b) /
                                      h) ∂μ.prod (η.prod (ProbabilityTheory.gaussianReal 0 1)) ≤
                            2 * Real.pi * C₀ * h ^ 2 * κ / σ
